title: 日本20年期收益率：创1996年来新高，债市抛售会否波及全球？
speaker: Hilton Chang

segments.en: Welcome back. You're watching the China show going into the open today.
segments.zh: 欢迎回来，您正在收看《中国节目》，今天开盘在即。

segments.en: It's really a big cross-asset macro story with the yield space and the bond lead on the long end continuing to give the 20-year in Japan.
segments.zh: 这是一个重要的跨资产宏观主题：收益率和长端债券领跌，日本20年期国债收益率持续上行。

segments.en: Just hit the highest since 1996 following its 10-year cousin yesterday.
segments.zh: 继昨日10年期收益率之后，20年期收益率触及1996年以来最高水平。

segments.en: We have a rate decision coming here out of the RBNZ and a glance at the energy market tells you everything you need to know about this loop, this doom cycle we're in.
segments.zh: 新西兰联储即将公布利率决议，而能源市场的表现已足以说明当前这种循环和压力周期。

segments.en: As I said for a back-to-back rate hike as well, just given those inflationary pressures as well.
segments.zh: 正如我所说，考虑到通胀压力，可能会连续加息。

segments.en: So that doesn't seem like there's going to be any sort of a pause in this bond sell-off in any ways here today and you take a look at the macro picture, that seems to be dominating the moves that we're seeing.
segments.zh: 因此，今天债市的抛售似乎不会暂停，宏观因素主导了当前的市场波动。
